connector.name: Shopify MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Shopify Admin API with a ComfyUI bridge for AI product image generation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package shopify-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the miller-joe account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Admin API access token (shpat_...). See README for how to create a custom app on a dev store.

env.name: COMFYUI_URL
env.description: ComfyUI HTTP URL for bridge tools. When unset, generate_* bridge tools are disabled.

env.name: COMFYUI_DEFAULT_CKPT
env.description: Default ComfyUI checkpoint filename for bridge tools (default: sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors)
